summary: WP4 docsys-wp-design-navigation is ready for ImplementationDesign. Calibrate design/README.md as the stable design/system map and fact-source governance entry for the dual-entry documentation system: it should route readers to architecture, HARNESS flow, agent/skill design, usage scenarios, intent architecture, MCP, validator, schema/EA mapping, domain templates, marketing comparison, and research boundaries without duplicating deep content.
notes: Work package scope: docsys-wp-design-navigation / Design Navigation Calibration Work, fourth step in docsys-wp-information-architecture -> docsys-wp-root-readme-reduction -> docsys-wp-contributor-entrypoint -> docsys-wp-design-navigation -> docsys-wp-link-fact-verification. WP1, WP2, and WP3 are accepted prerequisites; root CONTRIBUTING.md now exists.

Intent graph mutation was not required for WP4. Existing graph context already captures the accepted dual-entry documentation system, stable design reference authority, content-boundary governance, DOC-03 deep-reference routing, DOC-04 placement governance, and the vertical trigger from contributor entrypoint work to design navigation work and then link/fact-source verification.

Viewpoint frame: Outcome Realization Viewpoint for docsys-entrypoint-routing, Requirements Realization Viewpoint for docsys-fact-source-core and docsys-authority-layer-boundaries, and Implementation and Migration Viewpoint for docsys-acceptance-core and docsys-vertical-delivery-chain. The affected views already carry explicit Viewpoint/Concern/Purpose/Scope/Rationale bindings.

Coverage proof for docsys-stable-design-reference: the element is delivered and has same-element mounted ExplicitAcceptanceTestcase-DOC-03. DOC-03 control point is that a reader searches from root README for getSystemArchitecture, semantic query, MCP, or mutation validation details; observation point is that the reader lands on design/mcp and design/validator references, with no duplicated deep specification in root README. The acceptance entrypoint is tests/explicit/entries/runDocumentationInformationArchitectureDecision.js#doc-03-stable-design-reference-routing.

Coverage proof for docsys-content-boundary-requirement: the element is delivered and has same-element mounted ExplicitAcceptanceTestcase-DOC-04. DOC-04 control point is that a maintainer adds a domain template, market comparison, research note, or stable design content; observation point is that the maintainer can decide whether content belongs in design/specific-domain, design/marketing, notes, or stable design docs. The acceptance entrypoint is tests/explicit/entries/runDocumentationInformationArchitectureDecision.js#doc-04-content-boundary-placement.

Acceptance evidence: argo.validateSystemArchitecture passed. argo.runArchitectureTests reported DOC-03 and DOC-04 passed, alongside DOC-01 and DOC-02 passed. The full architecture test run remains red only because of unrelated non-documentation failures ExplicitAcceptanceTestcase-W3-1-MutationEmbeddingVectorE2E and ExplicitAcceptanceTestcase-SP-03-DefaultVectorRetrieval; those failures are not used as WP4 coverage evidence.

MCP retrieval note: ordinary semantic getSystemArchitecture query was blocked by SEMANTIC_LIFECYCLE_FAILED with missing Element, ArchitectureRelationship, and View channels. IntentionDesign did not run initializeWorkspace because the tool description says it resets handoff artifacts. Graph-tidy full snapshot and getIntentElementContext reads were used instead for focused intent evidence.

ImplementationDesign boundary: update design/README.md as the stable design/system map and governance router. It should link or route to design/architecture.md, design/argo-harness/README.md, design/argo-harness/agents-and-skills.md, design/argo-harness/usage-scenarios/README.md, design/intent-architecture/README.md, design/mcp/意图架构 MCP 功能列表.md, design/validator/intent-architecture-mcp-validation.md, design/schema-ea-mapping.md, design/specific-domain/README.md, design/marketing/solution-comparison-argo-openspec-superpower-ecc.md, and notes/ research boundaries without copying deep specifications inline.

Dual-entry coherence boundary: keep root README as the quiet adoption/product router, root CONTRIBUTING.md as the contributor/governance entrypoint, and design/README.md as the stable design navigation and fact-source governance entry. design/README.md may mention this split but should not duplicate root README positioning or CONTRIBUTING.md operational detail.

Root implementation contract handling: do not invent or claim root OVERALL_ARCHITECTURE.md if direct repository evidence shows it is absent. If current implementation evidence shows such a file exists, refer to it truthfully; otherwise keep the fact-source wording honest and route to observed stable contracts such as tests/ARCHITECTURE.md.

Global handoff approval: the human pre-authorized approval gates and necessary stage commits for this orchestrated WP4 task. The handoff schema has additionalProperties=false and no approvedByHuman field, so global handoff approval is recorded here in notes.
